title: IDOR probing: many denied record ids
description: One actor requested many different records outside their scope. NEXORA answers 404 and records authz.denied (not_visible): the actor is enumerating ids.
false_positives: Stale bookmarks or links shared between teams after records were reassigned (usually few ids).
tuning: Raise count if users routinely follow old links; real enumeration produces dozens of distinct ids.
